notes: Compiled by the Clerk from the State's official returns; New Hampshire's section on page 29 of the PDF.

OpenElections keeps the Secretary's workbooks, downloaded by its contributors and renamed (https://github.com/openelections/openelections-data-nh/tree/master/raw/2022/general); the Secretary's site refuses programs. The layout and figures are the Secretary's, but the copy reaches us through a third party, so it is not marked official.

Compiled by MEDSL from the Secretary of State's returns (https://github.com/MEDSL/2022-elections-official); one row per town or ward, office, candidate and count stage. A secondary source: its figures are not marked official here.
gaps: The Secretary of State's own results files

Towns and wards report to the Secretary of State, whose results workbooks are the official record of every contest; the Secretary's site refuses programs (it answers with an Akamai 'Access Denied'), so none was read from it. John can save them from the results page in his own browser.

Canaan: the workbook copy prints Donald C. Bolduc 633, Maggie Hassan 930; MEDSL's compilation prints Donald C. Bolduc 930, Maggie Hassan 633. Only the compilation's figures make the towns add up to the Clerk of the House's official figures, so they are stored for Canaan (the copy's are very likely transposed); every other town is the copy's. The FEC's statewide figures (Donald C. Bolduc 275,631, Maggie Hassan 332,490) equal the copy's towns instead, so the two official compilations disagree; the Clerk's are kept as the control, and a check names the difference. The Secretary of State's own workbook would confirm the town's figures.
United States Senator: the FEC against the Clerk

The two official federal compilations of the State's returns disagree: Donald C. Bolduc: Clerk 275,928, FEC 275,631; Maggie Hassan: Clerk 332,193, FEC 332,490. Nothing is changed: the Clerk of the House's figures are the contest's control, and the FEC's are only compared.
The workbook's town rows and the Totals row it prints differ (State Representative Rockingham 32, Scatter: towns 5, printed 3); both are kept as printed, so the store's check names the difference.
